Title: Axiom2d
Description: Custom modular 2D game engine in Rust with wgpu rendering, Rapier physics, and Bevy ECS.
FullDescription:
A modular, LLM-optimized 2D game engine built from scratch in Rust. The workspace spans 9 subsystem crates — rendering (wgpu/WGSL/DirectX12 with lyon vector tessellation), physics (Rapier2d), audio (cpal + fundsp DSP synthesis), ECS (bevy_ecs integration), UI, input, scene graph, and asset loading. Each subsystem is an optional feature gate so games only link what they use.

Includes a card game demo integrating terrain generation (dual-grid + wave function collapse), a living documentation system auto-generated from tests, snapshot regression testing for rendering (insta + image-compare), and multiple build profiles for development, profiling, and size-optimized production. The engine is designed with code clarity and token efficiency in mind, enabling rapid AI-assisted prototyping.

Title: WhisCorTex
Description: Dual-personality AI Twitch VTuber bot running entirely on local open-source models.
FullDescription:
Two independent AI characters — WhisCor and Cortex — run simultaneously on local Ollama (Llama 3.1) instances, each with their own personality, conversation history, and TTS voice. They interact with Twitch chat and with each other while managing a shared spaceship simulation that degrades over time.

Key systems: Piper TTS with hot-reloadable pronunciation dictionary, VTube Studio integration for lip sync and avatar expressions, RAG-based long-term memory via SQLite vector embeddings (embeddinggemma), a priority message queue (VOICE > CHAT > AUTONOMOUS) with interrupt handling, LLM-callable tools for memory and ship system management, and a FastAPI dashboard for monitoring. An interaction logger captures all messages with evaluation scores for dataset generation. Target latency under 2 seconds total. Built entirely on local software — no cloud APIs required.

Title: WavReconstruction
Description: Converts WAV audio into FastTracker 2 Extended Module (.xm) tracker files using ML and evolutionary optimization.
FullDescription:
A hybrid pipeline that converts standard audio recordings back into the symbolic notation of tracker music. The pipeline chains Demucs stem separation → Basic Pitch neural transcription → instrument matching against a GM soundbank → 8-channel greedy allocation → quantization → XM binary serialization, then optionally applies CMA-ES evolutionary refinement using a perceptual multi-resolution STFT loss.

The core challenge: standard MIDI converters fail on polyphonic audio because harmonic overlap causes octave confusion and peak-picking produces 90% spurious notes. WavReconstruction solves this with supervised NMF constrained by neural priors, and a differentiable tracker renderer enabling gradient-based pitch optimization via Spectral Optimal Transport loss.

Phase 3 complete with 264 passing tests. Includes a custom PerceiverTF + Transformer model (~45M parameters) trained on synthetic tracker data with curriculum learning (1→4→8 channels), an async Mod Archive scraper for dataset building, and complete XM binary reader/writer with round-trip validation.

Title: AudioEvolve
Description: Reconstructs WAV audio into tracker modules via hybrid neural transcription and evolutionary optimization.
FullDescription:
AudioEvolve tackles the hard version of audio transcription: recovering which notes play when in a polyphonic recording, assigned to the actual tracker instruments. Unlike standard MIDI converters that fail from octave confusion and spurious note detection, AudioEvolve uses supervised fixed-dictionary NMF/SI-PLCA constrained by neural priors from Onsets&Frames, Basic Pitch, and MT3.

The pipeline: Demucs v4 stem separation → probabilistic neural transcription → NMF instrument matching → differentiable tracker rendering → perceptual loss optimization (multi-resolution mel-STFT + Spectral Optimal Transport) → CMA-ES refinement over discrete parameters. A WPF frontend (.NET 9) provides the user interface, invoking a Python engine (PyTorch 2.x) for all neural network inference and optimization, with libopenmpt for playback.

Evaluation uses synthetic ground truth: render a known tracker module → WAV → reconstruct → compare, providing perfect note labels without hand annotation. Targets .mod, .xm, and .it formats with progressive difficulty.

Title: OctarineCodex
Description: Tactical RPG engine with an 8-dimensional magic system, LDtk level integration, and DefaultEcs architecture.
FullDescription:
A .NET 8 / MonoGame RPG engine where all systemic interactions are driven by an 8-dimensional vector space (EleAspects) representing physical properties: Solidum (solidity), Febris (temperature), Ordinem (orderedness), Lumines (luminance), Varias (manifold/time-space), Inertiae (density), Subsidium (helpfulness), and Spatium (distance). Players collect trading-card-style cards that procedurally generate worlds for an autonomous agent to explore — loot converts back into cards, creating a feedback loop.

Features seamless LDtk multi-level integration with automatic C# code generation from .ldtk files, layered Aseprite character animation (state machine + per-layer compositing), a DefaultEcs ECS architecture, event-driven messaging, and collision resolution. Clean architecture with SOLID principles throughout; a phased ECS migration is managed via feature flags for safe transitions. Named after Path of Exile's Octarine — a theoretical 8th color of magic.

Title: RME — Ratcheting Micro-Evolution
Description: Evolutionary code generation framework using weak LLMs and compiler-guided selection.
FullDescription:
RME solves complex coding problems using 7B parameter models that most LLM systems would consider insufficient. Instead of asking a weak model to fix broken code, RME makes mutations so small that even a 7B model succeeds occasionally — then uses evolutionary selection to accumulate improvements. A ratchet mechanism ensures the best solution never regresses.

The fitness loop uses only deterministic signals: compiler diagnostics, test results, branch coverage, and cyclomatic complexity — no LLM judgment in evaluation. A MAP-Elites population with test-bitmap features maintains solution diversity. Nine mutation types range from error-guided fixes to structural refactors. A strong model (Sonnet/Opus) writes executable property tests; the 7B model implements to pass them.

Built as a multi-crate Rust workspace: rme-core (business logic), rme-cli (headless CI interface), rme-tui (interactive ratatui dashboard with setup/monitor/specs/runs tabs), and rme-props (property test runner). Supports local Ollama, Anthropic API, and tiered model escalation (7B → Haiku → Sonnet → Opus).

Title: dod-guard
Description: Anti-cheat Definition of Done quality gate for Claude Code, published as a Claude Code plugin.
FullDescription:
dod-guard prevents the common failure mode where an AI or developer converts machine-checkable tests to manual-only claims to fake completion. Proof commands are stored in locked MCP storage (~/.claude/dod-store/), not in editable markdown — so editing the rendered file cannot weaken verification.

Core features: 8 proof predicate types (exit_code, output_contains, regex matching, TDD enforcement), SHA256 tamper detection across all proofs, and an amendment audit trail requiring a mandatory reason for any criteria change. The TDD predicate rejects tests that pass on first run — proving they were written before the implementation existed.

The /interview skill automates requirements gathering: researches the codebase, asks targeted one-at-a-time questions, confirms a requirements summary, applies company-wide baseline proofs per work type (lint, format, regression tests, two-layer integration tests, manual review), then creates a locked DoD ready to pass to /goal for autonomous implementation.

Title: FNAF-ai
Description: Reinforcement learning agent for Five Nights at Freddy's using SMiRL surprise minimization and a Dreamer world model.
FullDescription:
An RL agent that learns to survive in Five Nights at Freddy's by minimizing surprise rather than maximizing reward — using SMiRL (Surprise Minimization RL). In a horror game, novel states signal danger, so the agent learns to stay in familiar states by minimizing KL divergence from its historical state distribution.

The world model is a Dreamer-style Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM) combining a GRU deterministic hidden state for temporal memory with a stochastic categorical latent, enabling offline imagination rollouts without direct environment interaction.

The agent uses online PPO training bootstrapped with behavioral cloning from human demonstrations, log-polar foveated vision (high resolution at cursor center, lower at periphery — 64×64×4 output from full-screen capture), and cross-attention fusion of vision and stereo audio. Action space covers 17 keyboard actions plus continuous mouse. Auto game cycle management handles death detection and restarts. Curriculum learning scales from 1 to 50 animatronics across 7 stages. ~16M parameters targeting RTX 4060 (8GB VRAM).

Title: CodeEvolution
Description: AlphaEvolve-style closed-loop genetic programming for Rust using LLMs and compiler-guided fitness.
FullDescription:
CodeEvolution implements an evolutionary code optimization loop: mark EVOLVE-BLOCK regions in Rust source, generate mutations via a multi-LLM ensemble (Claude, Codex, Qwen2.5-Coder via Ollama), evaluate fitness through a cascade of hard gates (compile → tests → Clippy lints → benchmarks → LLM judgment), then iterate with OpenEvolve MAP-Elites island-based evolution.

Designed for constrained hardware targeting RTX 4060 (8GB VRAM) with local Llama.cpp orchestration. Supports checkpoint/resume with full evolution history tracking. A tech debt ledger tracks accumulated improvements across runs. SEARCH/REPLACE diff normalization handles LLM output malformations. Achieves ShinkaEvolve-style sample efficiency: 150–1,440 evaluations per 3-hour session.

Title: PoEMCP
Description: MCP server for Path of Exile 1 & 2 build analysis with 32+ tools for AI-assisted theorycrafting.
FullDescription:
A Model Context Protocol server exposing 32+ tools for deep Path of Exile build analysis to AI assistants. Supports both PoE1 and PoE2 with separate server entrypoints.

PoE1 features: character import via poe.ninja/GGG API/Path of Building codes, passive tree analysis (keystones, notables, masteries, atlas tree), skill/support gem databases with compatibility validation, defense calculations (EHP, armor, evasion, block, resistances, stun), damage calculations (hit DPS, DoT, ailments), mana reservation tracking, and build validation.

PoE2 features mirror PoE1 but with PoE2-specific mechanics: Spirit system (flat costs replacing percentage mana reservation), Ward defense (absorbs all damage types, auto-regenerates), updated ailment rules, 50% block cap, and Mobalytics integration. Full async Python with SQLAlchemy local database, httpx for API calls, and optional Playwright for trade site scraping.

Title: CodeContextMcp
Description: MCP server for semantic C# code navigation using Roslyn, enabling AI-assisted codebase understanding.
FullDescription:
A Model Context Protocol server exposing 15+ semantic analysis tools for C# codebases to AI assistants. Built on Roslyn (Microsoft.CodeAnalysis), it provides symbol search with partial/exact matching, code compilation analysis, file-by-file code context retrieval, directory tree traversal with token budget controls, and VCS status tracking via LibGit2Sharp.

Designed for use with Claude Code on large .NET solutions — token budget management and content truncation strategies ensure responses fit within LLM context windows. Supports multi-project solutions with project switching. Enables AI assistants to navigate and understand large C# codebases without requiring full file dumps.

Title: SearchitBreakher
Description: Infinite voxel world engine with chunk streaming, face culling, and distance shading, built on MonoGame.
FullDescription:
A voxel graphics engine built on MonoGame (.NET 8/9) featuring chunk-based streaming for infinite worlds (32³ voxels per chunk), dynamic load/unload based on player position, optimized mesh generation with per-face culling (only exposed faces rendered), distance-based vertex shading for depth perception, and persistence via a custom .gox binary format.

The library architecture cleanly separates the MonoGame-agnostic core (fully testable with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection) from the thin rendering wrapper. Includes SearchitContextExporter — a companion CLI tool that bundles the full project codebase for AI context windows, with git-tracked file filtering, hierarchical directory tree visualization, and GPT-4o token counting via TiktokenSharp.

Title: ClaudeConfig
Description: GUI tool for viewing and editing Claude Code global configuration, with cross-machine sync.
FullDescription: A desktop GUI application for managing Claude Code configuration files across two Windows machines. Provides visual editing of the global Claude Code configuration, browsing installed MCP servers and hooks, and a sync mechanism for keeping configuration images consistent between machines — an alternative to manually editing JSON files and copying them manually.

Title: Pixel Art MCP
Description: MCP server for reading and writing 8x8-tile indexed pixel art PNGs.
FullDescription: A Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants the ability to read and write pixel art in PNG format. Operates on 8×8 tile grids with indexed color palettes, enabling AI-driven pixel art creation and editing workflows. Exposes tools for reading tile data, modifying individual pixels or tiles, and writing the result back to PNG.

Title: LilyTracker2
Description: LilyPond music sheet editor — generates sheet music PDF from spreadsheet data.
FullDescription: A desktop GUI application that generates LilyPond music notation from .ods spreadsheet data, producing professional-quality sheet music PDFs. Provides a visual editor for composing music in a spreadsheet-like interface while abstracting the complexities of raw LilyPond syntax. The workflow: edit notes in the GUI → generate LilyPond source → compile to PDF.

Title: ResourceFlow
Description: Factory resource flow analyzer with GUI for modeling and optimizing production chains.
FullDescription: A desktop GUI tool for analyzing and designing factory production chains. Models resource flow between production stages, calculates throughput bottlenecks, and visualizes factory layouts. Features a dedicated factory design tab for planning production lines and a clean data model layer separating business logic from UI.

Title: WorstBench
Description: Worst-case LLM reliability benchmark — tests failure modes under adversarial conditions.
FullDescription: A benchmark framework targeting the worst-case reliability of LLMs rather than average performance. Tests how models behave under adversarial prompting, edge cases, and conditions specifically designed to elicit failures, providing a more honest picture of model reliability than standard capability benchmarks.

Title: Voiceover TTS
Description: Scene-aware voiceover text-to-speech with semantic scene parsing and subtitle export.
FullDescription: A text-to-speech tool that goes beyond simple TTS by understanding scene context. Parses input into semantic scenes, selects appropriate voice characteristics per scene (tone, pacing, emotion), and produces voiced output with synchronized subtitle export.
